card_measure: Near-white occupancy and co-located dark glyphs with a white ring, checked on each of the four original rows.
photograph_comparison: For frames 90–169 align source frame 170 using exposed features above the caption. Compare interior [200,1355,933,1660] to that independent neighbor alignment.

end_strip.frame_selection: Inspect every one of the last 30 frames. Count the original near-white run at x1071 within y1510..1709 of length >=18 with >=18 co-located original near-white pixels at x1065. A retained in-box strip keeps >65% of those pixels above 235 in all channels.

speaker_id: At 16.60 s the red speaker identifier and lower black dialogue occupy the same selection. The fifth run retains the name and removes the dialogue. Its 150 OCR matches all correspond to the speaker name. The manifest targets narrative caption cards. The final white-strip finding is independent of speaker-name interpretation.
